reviews.title: Paid 179.99 a year for two week shipping
reviews.comment: I pay 179.99 annually for a My Best Buy Total membership which includes two day shipping. I placed my order on November 26th.  It is December 7th and I have still not received my product. This is unacceptable and I WILL be cancelling my membership. I am even considering making the three hour drive to the nearest Micro Center for my future PC building needs.
reviews.author: AlexC
